card.line: Tarsus was a well-known city in Cilicia and the hometown of Saul, who became the apostle Paul. He was sent back there when his life was in danger.

moments.title: Ananias is sent to a man from Tarsus
moments.text: The Lord tells Ananias to go to Straight Street in Damascus and ask for Saul of Tarsus, who is praying. Ananias is sent to him so Saul can see again.

moments.title: Saul is sent off to Tarsus
moments.text: After the Grecian Jews try to kill Saul, the brothers take him down to Caesarea. From there they send him off to Tarsus.

moments.title: Barnabas looks for Saul
moments.text: Barnabas goes to Tarsus to look for Saul. When he finds him, he brings him back to Antioch, and they teach large numbers of people there.

moments.title: Paul speaks of his hometown
moments.text: Paul tells a Roman officer that he is a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. He asks to speak to the people.

moments.title: Paul tells where he was born
moments.text: Paul tells the crowd he was born in Tarsus of Cilicia but raised in Jerusalem. He says he was taught by Gamaliel and was zealous for God.
